name: Mirt. Skazki holodnogo kraja
source: Mirt is the city on the edge of the world; cold, unwelcoming, unaccustomed, but if it takes you — you will never be able to leave it. Student Anton went to Mirt on summer earnings, but discovers that the life in the city is not so simple. Strange and scary events took place here few years ago. Or took place even for now?
translation: Mirt是一座位于世界尽头的城市：寒冷、冷漠而又陌生。但如果它接纳了你，你就再也无法离开。学生Anton来到Mirt，想趁暑假打工挣钱，却发现这座城市里的生活并不简单。几年前，这里曾发生过一些离奇而可怕的事。又或者，那些事至今仍在发生？
